title: twinforge.fit
description: Fit a physics-grounded latent twin to a building's history. Long-running; emits streaming progress events. Backed by REASONER-JEPA-NEXT substrate.

substrate_version.description: Pinned substrate checkpoint. Use 'random_init' to run the ablation baseline.

max_wall_seconds.description: Hard wall-time budget. Twin must fit within this or fail.

freeze_substrate.description: If true, only the per-building adapter is updated; substrate weights are frozen.

validate_held_out.description: Run held-out 7d energy-MAPE + zone-temp-RMSE checks before reporting success.

x-falsifiability: fit completes in ≤ 24h on a single H100 (or equivalent)
held-out 7d energy MAPE ≤ 10% on LBNL B59, Pecan Street, and one synthetic building
zone temp RMSE ≤ 1.0 °C over a 24h horizon
substrate ablation: random_init baseline must NOT converge within budget — if it does, the substrate is not earning its keep
